correctness.rationale: All possible factors containing 1 through 4 ones are controlled by consecutive-one shortest spans. A bijective nonnegative quadruple parameterization follows, with exact two-case inversion of ordered internal gaps and exterior slack. Direct separate sliding-window enumeration tested all 33649 words n=4..22, with algebraic checks to n=200.

value.rationale: Prefix-normal profiles are canonical one-sided jumbled indices, with inverse-fiber cardinality quantifying reconstruction ambiguity. The known p4 enumeration counts representatives but does not determine populations in each fiber. This natural complete fixed-composition family yields a sharp maximizer, all class sizes, a rational second-moment series and an exact asymptotic collision constant.
